<module id="traffic_light">
    <description>A traffic light controller with a pedestrian button.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="rst_n">Active-low reset signal.</input>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal.</input>
        <input id="pass_request">Request signal for pedestrians to cross.</input>
        <output id="clock" width_description="[7:0]">Internal counter value.</output>
        <output id="red">Red signal for the traffic light.</output>
        <output id="yellow">Yellow signal for the traffic light.</output>
        <output id="green">Green signal for the traffic light.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="idle">Idle state.</parameter>
        <parameter id="s1_red">State 1: Red signal.</parameter>
        <parameter id="s2_yellow">State 2: Yellow signal.</parameter>
        <parameter id="s3_green">State 3: Green signal.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <register id="cnt" width_description="[7:0]" description="Internal counter for timing control."></register>
        <register id="state" width_description="[1:0]" description="Current state of the traffic light controller."></register>
        <register id="p_red" width_description="[0:0]" description="Previous red signal value."></register>
        <register id="p_yellow" width_description="[0:0]" description="Previous yellow signal value."></register>
        <register id="p_green" width_description="[0:0]" description="Previous green signal value."></register>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        // State transition logic
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                state <= idle;
                p_red <= 1'b0;
                p_yellow <= 1'b0;
                p_green <= 1'b0;
            end else begin
                case(state)
                    idle: begin
                        state <= s1_red;
                        p_red <= 1'b0;
                        p_yellow <= 1'b0;
                        p_green <= 1'b0;
                    end
                    s1_red: begin
                        if(cnt == 3) begin
                            state <= s3_green;
                            p_red <= 1'b1;
                            p_yellow <= 1'b0;
                            p_green <= 1'b0;
                        end else begin
                            state <= s1_red;
                            p_red <= 1'b1;
                            p_yellow <= 1'b0;
                            p_green <= 1'b0;
                        end
                    end
                    s2_yellow: begin
                        if(cnt == 3) begin
                            state <= s1_red;
                            p_red <= 1'b0;
                            p_yellow <= 1'b1;
                            p_green <= 1'b0;
                        end else begin
                            state <= s2_yellow;
                            p_red <= 1'b0;
                            p_yellow <= 1'b1;
                            p_green <= 1'b0;
                        end
                    end
                    s3_green: begin
                        if(cnt == 3) begin
                            state <= s2_yellow;
                            p_red <= 1'b0;
                            p_yellow <= 1'b0;
                            p_green <= 1'b1;
                        end else begin
                            state <= s3_green;
                            p_red <= 1'b0;
                            p_yellow <= 1'b0;
                            p_green <= 1'b1;
                        end
                    end
                    default: begin
                        state <= idle;
                        p_red <= 1'b0;
                        p_yellow <= 1'b0;
                        p_green <= 1'b0;
                    end
                endcase
            end
        end
        
        // Counting logic
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if(!rst_n)begin
                cnt <= 8'd10;
            end else begin
                if(pass_request && green)begin
                    cnt <= 8'd10;
                end else if(!green && p_green)begin
                    cnt <= 8'd60;
                end else if(!yellow && p_yellow)begin
                    cnt <= 8'd5;
                end else if(!red && p_red)begin
                    cnt <= 8'd10;
                end else begin
                    cnt <= cnt - 8'd1;
                end
            end
        end
        
        // Output assignment
        always@(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)begin
            if(!rst_n)begin
                {red,yellow,green} <= 3'b000;
            end else begin
                {red,yellow,green} <= {p_red,p_yellow,p_green};
            end
        end
    </implementation>
</module>
